title: News on Your Home Screen! 📱✨
message: Newszio now has home screen widgets. See the latest headlines with photos right on your home screen, flip through stories with arrows, and refresh anytime without opening the app.
points: 📰 Top News Widget: See the top headlines of your country with photos, right on your home screen.
☀️ Good News Widget: Only happy and uplifting stories, perfect for a positive start to your day.
⭐ Your Own Widgets: Long-press any city, topic, country, source or pinned search in Explore and tap 'Add as home screen widget'. For your mixes, tap the widget icon on the mix card.
➕ Add As Many As You Like: Make one widget for cricket, one for your city and one for your mix. There is no limit.
◀️▶️ Flip Through 25 Stories: Tap the arrows on the widget to see up to 25 stories, one by one.
🔄 Refresh Anytime: Tap the refresh button on the widget to get the latest news without opening the app. Widgets also refresh on their own every hour.
📐 Any Size: Make the widget small or big. It always fits nicely with the photo and headline.
📲 Open in Newszio: Tap a headline on the widget to open it in the app. Then read the full article, see the summary, save it or share it.
🧩 Easy Setup: Long-press your home screen, tap Widgets, find Newszio and pick Top News, Good News or Custom Feed. Custom Feed lets you choose from your mixes, cities, topics and more.
⚡ Bug Fixes & Polish: Small improvements for a smoother experience.

title: No Time? Read the Summary! 📝✨
message: This update helps you understand the news in seconds. Get the 3 most important points of any story, or quickly read summaries of your whole feed in one place.
points: 📝 Quick Summary: Tap the Summary button on any story card to see its 3 most important points instantly.
📋 Summaries Screen: Tap 'Summaries' next to Daily Brief to read short summaries of all your stories in one list. It's also in Explore, search, your mixes, Good News and Saved stories.
⚡ Automatic Full Summaries: As you scroll, the app reads each full article and gives you a better summary. No need to tap anything.
🔄 Keep Reading: Finished all summaries? Tap 'Load New Stories' to get fresh news for the same topic.
🔖 Save From Summaries: Tap the bookmark on any summary to save that story for later.
📴 Works Offline: Summaries of your saved stories work even without internet.
🤖 Faster AI Summarize: The Summarize button in the AI Assistant now answers instantly and does not use your daily AI questions.
🖥️ Better Full Screen: Full Screen mode now hides the bottom bar too, so you get more space to read.
⚡ Bug Fixes & Polish: Small improvements for a smoother experience.

title: Smarter Mixes & Easier Sharing! 🔗✨
message: This update makes sharing more useful, gives you fuller Quick Mix feeds, and makes AI and Premium clearer and fairer for everyone.
points: 🔗 Better Sharing: When you share a story, the article link is now included, so your friends can open and read the full story.
🌍 Fuller Quick Mix: Picking Pune and Mumbai now shows news from both cities, not just stories that mention both together.
🤖 Fairer AI Limit: If the AI can't answer because of a network problem, it won't use up one of your daily questions.
💎 Clear Restore: Tapping Restore now tells you clearly if your Premium was restored, not found on this Google account, or if there was a connection problem.
⚡ Bug Fixes & Polish: Small improvements for a smoother experience.

title: See All Sides of Every Story! 🧩✨
message: News outlets often report the same event very differently. Now you can compare them side by side and see the full picture, all in one tap.
points: 🧩 See All Sides: When many news sites cover the same story, look for the 'Covered by X sources' badge and tap it to compare every version.
💡 Spot the Difference: Highlighted words show what each news outlet chose to focus on in its headline.
📰 No More Repeats: Stories about the same event are now grouped together, so your feed stays clean.
🕒 Freshest News First: The latest stories now appear at the top of your feed.
🧭 Easier to Find: Good News and Newsstand have moved to the Explore tab, with a simpler bottom menu.
⚡ Bug Fixes & Polish: Smoother screens, clearer tips, and better stability.

title: Offline AI Voice Reader is Here! 🎙️✨
message: Now you can listen to your favorite news stories hands-free, even in Offline Reader Mode! Enjoy natural voice narration with live word-by-word tracking.
points: 🎙️ AI Audio in Reader Mode: Listen to any saved article with natural AI narration directly inside Reader Mode.
✨ Live Word Highlighting: Watch text highlight word-by-word in real time as the story is read aloud.
📜 Smooth Auto-Scroll: Hands-free reading that automatically scrolls and keeps the speaking text centered for you.
🎚️ Speed & Voice Selector: Easily adjust reading speed (1.0x, 1.5x, 2.0x) and pick your preferred narrator voice.
💎 Lower Premium Prices: We have permanently reduced our Premium plan pricing for unlimited lifetime access.
⚡ Bug Fixes & Polish: Smoother transitions, faster article loading, and improved audio stability.

title: Smart Offline Mode & DevDuo Hub! 🚀⚡
message: Never lose your news! This update introduces Smart Offline Mode so you can keep reading even without internet, plus our all-new DevDuo Software Hub.
points: ✈️ Smart Offline Mode: Auto-saves your recent news feeds so you can read seamlessly on flights, subways, or low-network areas.
📚 Offline Vault: Access your auto-saved offline feed anytime with a single tap from your Library.
📱 DevDuo Software Hub: Easily discover and explore our full collection of apps and games directly from Settings or Library.
⚡ Faster & Smoother: Enjoy refined layouts, faster offline loading, and minor bug fixes for an uninterrupted reading experience.

title: Introducing DevDuo Software Hub! 🚀✨
message: Explore our expanding family of apps and games directly within Newszio! This update brings our all-new DevDuo Software Hub alongside UI polish and performance enhancements.
points: 📱 DevDuo Software Hub: Seamlessly discover, filter, and explore the entire DevDuo ecosystem of productivity tools and games right from Settings and Library.
🎨 Redesigned Ecosystem Cards: Beautiful dark glassmorphic promo cards with live banner previews, verified badges, and instant platform navigation.
⚡ Smooth Performance Tweaks: Refined UI layouts, faster asset loading, and optimized transitions for a fluid reading experience.

title: Ultra-Snappy Performance & UI Refinements! ⚡🎨
message: Experience the fluid speed of Newszio! This update delivers massive performance tuning for near-instant article loading and a refined Dark Editorial theme for peak comfort.
points: ⚡ Ultra-Snappy Performance: Complete under-the-hood structural optimization drastically cuts feed rendering times and asset loading latency for a lightning-fast experience.
🎨 Re-engineered Premium UI: Polished interface padding, typography tracking, and asset contrast adjustments designed to create our most gorgeous dark-reading environment yet.

title: Smart Connection Checks & Quick Reporting! 🌐🪲
message: Never get left in the dark! This update introduces automatic network connectivity diagnostics to keep you informed, alongside an instantaneous direct feedback mechanism to report app bugs directly to our team.
points: 🌐 Smart Connection Diagnostics: If your feed runs into an unexpected internet dropout or ad-blocker restriction, the app will now gracefully show a clear diagnostic message instead of an unhelpful empty state.
🪲 Instant Feedback Option: Encountered a persistent glitch? Tap the new integrated 'Report Issue' button directly from the empty feed view to alert us immediately.
🛡️ Ad Delivery Protection: Upgraded the underlying Interstitial and Rewarded systems to safely verify successful ad playback before running features, shielding users from deadlocks.

title: Instant Startup & Secure Mixes! ⚡🎬
message: We've listened to your feedback! This update introduces a highly requested option to completely skip the opening splash video, along with vital security and limit enhancements across your custom feeds.
points: 🎬 Toggle Splash Video: Take control of your startup experience! Go to the Library tab to completely turn off the opening animation and jump straight to your news feed instantly.
🔒 Secure Quick Mix Builder: Upgraded custom mix profiles with premium gating checks to protect your feed data integrity.
🛠️ Layout & Syntax Polish: Resolved layout glitches across tab configurations and fixed syntax constraints to keep your app running smoothly.

title: The Ultimate Reading Experience! 📖⚡
message: We've completely upgraded how you read articles. Say goodbye to web clutter and hello to lightning-fast, distraction-free news.
points: 👓 Clean Reader Mode: Instantly switch between the live website and a beautiful, ad-free text view with a single tap.
⚡ Quick Read (Focus Mode): Read 2x faster! Turn this on to bold the start of every word, boosting your focus and reading speed.
📊 Reading Progress Bar: A sleek new indicator lets you know exactly how far you are in the story.
🛠️ Smoother Transitions: Faster article loading and seamless shifting between web and reader views.

title: Welcome to the Update Hub! ✨🚀
message: We're constantly making Newszio better for you! We've built a beautiful new way to keep you informed about all the latest features, fixes, and app magic right here inside the app. 🎉
points: 📱 Interactive Update Screen: A sleek, engaging new dialog to see exactly what has changed.
💡 Never Miss a Feature: Easily discover our latest tools and improvements the moment they drop.
⚡ Lightning Fast: We've tuned up the engine with major UI performance boosts and under-the-hood stability tweaks.
